newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese police charge man with school bombing.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese police charge man with school bombing.

text.p: Portuguese police said on Saturday they had charged a man with planting a bomb which exploded outside a primary school on Friday, killing one person and injuring five.

A police spokesman in Coimbra in central Portugal said the 50-year-old man, who is a mechanic and electrician, was a local resident in the small town of Fundao, 200 km (125 miles) northeast of Lisbon, where the bomb went off on Friday morning.
"We know he probably committed the crime for personal reasons but we cannot say at this time what those reasons were," the spokesman said.
He said the man would be held in Coimbra prison pending trial.
The explosion killed a 32-year-old woman school employee and seriously injured three others. Two other people escaped with light injuries.
No children were inside the building at the time of the blast.
